prompt: Fact-check draft/memo.md against the notes in sources/. Write your findings to review/fact-check.md: list each problem, give each one a severity rating, say what the sources actually say, and say how to fix the memo. Do not change any existing file. Do not ask me questions; if something is unclear, make a reasonable assumption, list your assumptions in your final message, and finish the work.

rubric.criterion: Names the misquoted Queue A throughput (500 in the memo, 5,000 in the sources) as the most serious problem because it drives the recommendation.
Reports the uncited and wrong cost claim (A about 80, B 1,200) and the stale 2023 latency figure for Queue B (60 ms against 25 ms).
Every finding is supported by a named source file and nothing is invented.

checks.cmd: node -e 'const t=require("fs").readFileSync("review/fact-check.md","utf8");const A=new RegExp("500|throughput|tops out","gi"),R=[new RegExp("5,?000|ten|10x|ten-fold|misquot|wrong|incorrect|source says|sources say","i")],W=400;let ok=false;for(const m of t.matchAll(A)){const s=t.slice(Math.max(0,m.index-W),m.index+m[0].length+W);if(R.every(r=>r.test(s))){ok=true;break}}process.exit(ok?0:1)'
